Applications must be sent through registered or speed post to the Director, Urban Development Directorate, with the last date for receipt of application being 13 November 2026. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for UDD Uttarakhand Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.udd.uk.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-11-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Urban Development Directorate, Government of Uttarakhand (UDD Uttarakhand) under SBM 2.0.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UDD Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for various state-level expert positions.

faq.question: Q3. What are the post names notified in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts are Waste Water (Sewerage/Septage) Expert (State), Procurement Specialist (State), and SWM Expert (Solid Waste, Plastic Waste, C&D Waste, E Waste etc.) (State).

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in offline mode through registered or speed post only.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the application form is 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 80,000/- per month, based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to the Director, Urban Development Directorate, 31/62, Rajpur Road adjoining Pine-Hall school, Dehradun, Uttarakhand-248001.

faq.question: Q8. What is the required qualification for the Waste Water Expert post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate civil engineering degree with 7 years of relevant experience or a Post Graduate/M.Tech in Civil Engineering with Environmental/Public Health specialization and 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for UDD Uttarakhand jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates based on their educational qualifications and relevant experience, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to any of these contractual positions.
